$comment: Repair axis (Phase 5, differentiator E). iFixit: the device-category endpoint of the iFixit API (robots.txt allows /api/2.0/wikis*; it disallows /api/2.0/search, see docs/CHALLENGES.md C-2). The brand's category is looked up by name; at most maxDevices of its device sub-categories (the last ones listed, which on iFixit are the newest models of a numbered line) are read for guide counts and the repairability score.
